question: A sum of Rs. 6,400 amounts to Rs. 8,848 in 4(1)/(2) years at a certain rate per annum at simple interest. What will be the amount (in Rs.) of a sum of Rs. 9,000 in 2(2)/(5) years at the same rate at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal 1 = Rs. 6,400

Amount 1 = Rs. 8,848 

Time 1 = 4(1)/(2) years = 9/2 years

Principal 2 = Rs. 9,000

Time 2 = 2(2)/(5) years = 12/5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest
